title: zenbu.language-data-compressed.v1
description: A release's releases/<release>/compressed.json: the gzipped copies of its SQLite and JSON files (issue 955). Written by language-data/pipeline/publish.py once, after every part it lists, and never overwritten. Each file is cut into parts of part_bytes of the original, the last part shorter, and each part is a gzip stream of its own, served as gzip data with no Content-Encoding. Unpacking a file's parts in order gives the file the manifest names, by its SHA-256.

release.description: The release ID, YYYY.MM.N, whose manifest is releases/<release>/manifest.json.

manifest_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of that manifest's bytes, as releases.json lists it.

part_bytes.description: How many bytes of the original each part holds, but the last.

files.description: The manifest's SQLite and JSON files, in its order.

name.description: The file's name in the manifest.

sha256.description: The file's SHA-256 in the manifest: what its parts unpack to.

bytes.description: The file's size in the manifest, unpacked.

key.description: The part's object key, content-addressed: files/<sha256>/<name>.part<N>.gz, N counting from 1.

bytes.description: The part's size as stored and served: gzip data.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the part's bytes as stored and served.
